stem.text: Let \( h \) be the function defined by \( h(x) = x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 9x + 2 \) on the closed interval \( [-2, 4] \).

parts.prompt: Find the \( x \)-coordinates of all critical points of \( h \) on the open interval \( (-2, 4) \).

worked_solution.text: Differentiate and set the derivative to zero.
Both roots lie in the interval.

points.criterion: Sets h'(x) = 3x^2 - 6x - 9 equal to zero, or an equivalent equation.
Gives x = -1 and x = 3, supported by the factored derivative.

parts.prompt: Find the absolute minimum value of \( h \) on \( [-2, 4] \). Justify your answer.

worked_solution.text: Evaluate h at both endpoints and both critical points.
The smallest candidate value is the absolute minimum.

points.criterion: Justifies with a candidates test that evaluates h correctly at both endpoints and at every critical point (candidates imported from part (a) are accepted), or with another complete global argument, and identifies the smallest value.
States the absolute minimum value -25, or the smallest value consistent with critical points imported from part (a).
